summary.intent: Fix the injection tab in the memory loop TUI to (1) test against all active memories not just matched ones, and (2) show clear INJECT/SKIP labels with reasons instead of raw meaningless scores. Then remove skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: The injection tab was refactored to use PreviewSelection() instead of SelectRelevant(), showing INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons and a summary line. Two new tests were added and committed. The command removal task was planned but not yet executed — the session ended at the planning stage.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped (with reasons), while SelectRelevant() only returns matches — PreviewSelection is the right call for UI that needs to show full injection decision context.
The memorylooptui package uses message types (testPromptResultMsg) passed through the root model to carry async results to tab views.
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command — it must be preserved even when removing insight-related commands.
skilldb and skilltui are separate packages under cmd/entire/cli/ that would need removal as part of the skill command cleanup.
The unusedwrite lint check fires when a struct field is set in a test but the test calls the tab's view() method directly rather than going through the full model update path.

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed from carrying just matches to carrying a full SelectionReport (matches + skipped with reasons).
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to populate testPromptResultMsg with the full report.
View now renders a summary line ('N would inject, M skipped'), INJECT label for matched memories, and SKIP label with reason for skipped ones. Raw score numbers removed.
Setting activeTab in tests was flagged by unusedwrite lint because tests call injectionTab.view() directly; fix was to remove the unused field assignments.
This file is a hook handler, not a command registration — it must be retained even when removing the insights command.

workflow: The unusedwrite lint check catches struct field assignments that are never read — direct tab view() calls in tests bypass the model update path, making activeTab assignments dead writes.
When a UI shows raw numeric scores, users cannot determine actionability — always surface the decision (inject/skip) and the reason, not the underlying score.
The plan was written before implementation started, and the user interrupted plan mode twice before the assistant proceeded directly to implementation.

friction: User had to interrupt the assistant twice when it entered plan mode before the assistant proceeded to implement directly.
The 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section contained 'Injection Detail' which has 'INJECT' as a substring, causing a false positive in the empty-state test assertion that needed fixing.
The unusedwrite lint warning required a follow-up edit to remove unused activeTab field assignments in tests — discovered only after running lint post-implementation.
open_items: Remove skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands and all related code (skilldb, skilltui, permissions packages) — planned but not executed, session ended at planning stage.
